text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr injured herself during training, so I've hurried her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I apologize. A whirling wind swept my legs out from under me.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: If I'd recoiled, however, the wind would have consumed me completely.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Let's return to training. The winds that blow back after the storm blow with even greater strength.
choice_data_list: You can blow back once your injury's healed.
You can blow back once your injury's healed.
If you're sure, then let's go.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Let's return to training. The winds that blow back after the storm blow with even greater strength.
choice_data_list: You can blow back once your injury's healed.
You can blow back once your injury's healed.
If you're sure, then let's go.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: But this injury will take some time to heal…
choice_data_list: And that means we'd better skip training today.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes… Yes, I wouldn't want to become any more of a burden, after all.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Okay. I'll focus on recovering from my injury for now.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: And then… I'll blow back even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, a very disappointed Yamanin Zephyr decides to rest.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Thank you! I will whip up a wind of greater ferocity than before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with that, Yamanin Zephyr and I return to the track. However…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: U-urgh… But… I have to ride the wind…
choice_data_list: I think we need to take the day off after all.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …I'm sorry. I misjudged my current condition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Doing her best not to put any weight on her injury, Yamanin Zephyr falls into dejection.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I may not be running like a gale… but I feel good.
choice_data_list: Don't push yourself any harder than this.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I know, I must be very careful. Please don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taking care not to strain her injury, Yamanin Zephyr continues training.
